'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''

****At least 93 [[Palestinians]] are killed and 40 others are missing in [[Israel]]i strikes on a residential building in [[Beit Lahia]] in northern [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/10/29/israel-pounds-north-gaza-lebanons-east-killing-over-100-people (Al Jazeera)]

*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Eastern Ukraine campaign]]
***[[Russia]] claims that it has taken the cities of [[Selydove]] and [[Hirnyk, Donetsk Oblast|Hirnyk]] in [[Donetsk Oblast]], [[Ukraine]], with [[Open data|open-source data]] indicating that [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian forces]] are advancing at their fastest pace in at least one year amid signs of [[North Korea]]n involvement in the war. ***At least six people are killed and 13 others are injured in overnight Russian attacks in [[Kharkiv]], [[Kherson]], and [[Kyiv]], Ukraine. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/two-people-injured-russias-drone-attack-ukraines-kyiv-mayor-says-2024-10-29/ (Reuters)]
**[[Head of the Chechen Republic]] [[Ramzan Kadyrov]] vows to retaliate harshly against Ukraine after a [[Drone warfare|drone strike]] targeted a [[Russian Special Forces University|Special Forces University]] in [[Gudermes]], [[Chechnya]], Russia, representing the first known drone attack in Chechnya by the [[Armed Forces of Ukraine]].
